sources.title: GitHub - manyanthra/KneeSense-AI: An intelligent medical imaging ...
sources.snippet: An intelligent medical imaging platform for automated Knee Osteoarthritis (OA) assessment and patient-specific implant planning. The project uses a trained ML model to classify Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grades from knee X-rays and generates a clinician-friendly report through a modern Flask web application. - manyanthra/KneeSense-AI
